exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix workstream-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: workstream-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

# Workstream is accepted by create and by both directions of the editable
# workstream/task transition.
exec card create --type workstream 'Release workstream'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create.txt
exec card issue edit workstream-1 --type task
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/edit.txt
exec card --json issue edit workstream-1 --type workstream
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/workstream.json

# Apply accepts workstream as a first-class type and builds nested containment.
exec card apply graph.json
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/applied.txt

# Removed kinds are rejected at the command boundary.
! exec card create --type decision 'Removed decision'
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/decision-error.txt
! exec card create --type mission 'Removed mission'
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/mission-error.txt
! exec card create --type epic 'Removed epic'
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/epic-error.txt

# List selects strict descendants and composes ancestor, state, and label
# filters. The ancestor itself and matching issues outside it are excluded.
exec card --json list --under workstream-1 --status ready --label team
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/workstream-list.jsonl
exec card --json list --under workstream-6 --status ready --label team
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/generic-list.jsonl

# Workstreams are directly claimable, while unqualified claim continues to
# compose generic --under scope with labels.
exec card --actor root-worker --json claim workstream-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/workstream-claim.json
exec card --actor geordi --json claim --under workstream-1 --label team
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/descendant-claim.json
exec card --actor data --json claim --under workstream-6 --label team
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/generic-claim.json

# Workstream closure is explicit and permits closed or cancelled direct
# children. The no-open-children notice remains parent-neutral.
! exec card close workstream-1
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/open-children-error.txt
exec card close workstream-3
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/close-nested-task.txt
exec card close workstream-2
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/close-nested-workstream.txt
exec card cancel workstream-4
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/cancel-child.txt
exec card --json close workstream-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/close-workstream.json

# Generic ancestor queries reject missing issues.
! exec card list --under workstream-missing
stderr 'issue not found'
! exec card claim --under workstream-missing
stderr 'issue not found'

-- graph.json --
{"version":1,"issues":[{"alias":"nested","title":"Nested workstream","type":"workstream","parent":{"id":"workstream-1"}},{"alias":"workstream-task","title":"Workstream task","type":"task","priority":1,"labels":{"values":["team"]},"parent":{"alias":"nested"}},{"alias":"other-child","title":"Other child","type":"task","labels":{"values":["other"]},"parent":{"id":"workstream-1"}},{"alias":"outside","title":"Outside task","type":"task","labels":{"values":["team"]}},{"alias":"generic","title":"Generic ancestor","type":"workstream"},{"alias":"generic-child","title":"Generic child","type":"task","labels":{"values":["team"]},"parent":{"alias":"generic"}}]}
